text: (e.g., MRI, ultrasound). The totality of findings provides compelling evidence that volume is a primary driver of muscle hypertrophy. However, a lack of data investigating the effects of higher training volumes precludes the ability to determine whether additional hypertrophic gains could be achieved from >10 weekly sets per muscle and, if so, at what point it would reach a threshold.
